overview: General and Physical Geography is a large block: 117 official questions (2008–2025). Two clusters dominate: India/AP physiography, drainage, soils and forests (47 Qs, asked every paper year) and natural hazards + disaster management (31 Qs, concentrated in 2012 and 2017). World landforms (17) were heavy in 2012. Formats: mostly one-liners; 2024 added matching, 'incorrect statement' and ordering items.

possibility.angle: Earth in the solar system – origin theories, stars, planets
possibility.what_they_ask: Which scholar proposed which origin theory, what star colour shows, planet with most moons (time-sensitive).

possibility.angle: Interior of the Earth, rocks, earthquake focus
possibility.what_they_ask: Core composition, rock class of granite, focus vs epicentre, meaning of '-logy' terms.

possibility.angle: Major landforms – world mountains, deserts, lakes, islands; ocean-floor relief; agents of landforms
possibility.what_they_ask: Location of a named feature (country/region), young vs old fold mountains, landform–agent matching, ocean relief features.

possibility.angle: Climate – weather instruments, rainfall types, cyclones, grasslands, cloud seeding
possibility.what_they_ask: Instrument for a variable, rain type by cause, cyclone rotation, heating process–mechanism matching.

possibility.angle: Structure and composition of the atmosphere
possibility.what_they_ask: Which layer hosts jets/meteors/ozone; which gas is not in normal air.

possibility.angle: Ocean water – currents, ENSO, salinity, bathymetry
possibility.what_they_ask: Ocean of origin of El Niño/La Niña, salinity ordering of water bodies, the term for sea-floor mapping.

possibility.evidence: 0 official Qs; related APPSC exams ask ocean basics
possibility.what_they_ask: Natural targets: spring vs neap tide (Sun–Moon alignment), cause of tides, tidal range sites (Gulf of Khambhat/Kutch), wave terms (crest, trough, swash).

possibility.angle: Physiography of India and AP – Himalayan divisions, Ghats, islands, passes, Tropic of Cancer
possibility.what_they_ask: Which State the Tropic crosses / does not cross, which hill range is (not) in the Eastern Ghats, Himalayan section between two rivers, island channel, AP oldest landmass.

possibility.angle: Climate of India and AP – monsoon, winter rain, local storms, heat waves
possibility.what_they_ask: Which monsoon gives AP most rain, which region has dry winters, where mango showers occur, heat-wave months.

possibility.angle: Drainage – AP rivers and projects, tributaries, waterfalls, Krishna water shares
possibility.what_they_ask: River of a project/barrage/fall, odd-one-out tributary, origin hills of AP rivers, tribunal shares in TMC, Telugu Ganga beneficiary.
Black soil properties and region, bhangar vs khadar, laterite formation conditions, soil-water terms.

possibility.angle: Vegetation and forest cover (India and AP)
possibility.what_they_ask: Most widespread forest type, AP's dominant density class and top district, mangrove ranking, ISFR percentages (time-sensitive).

possibility.angle: Natural hazards – floods, cyclones, earthquakes, landslides, avalanches, drought
possibility.what_they_ask: Most vulnerable region, hazard classification, causes ('all the above'), drought category by % deficiency, flood-prone share of India.

possibility.angle: Disaster management – institutions, Acts, committees, drills, international frameworks
possibility.what_they_ask: Who chairs which committee, nodal ministry, year of HPC, what the DM Act 2005 provides, name/place of a drill, location of tsunami centres.

traps.trap: Swaps a tributary between Godavari and Krishna [basin swap]
traps.spot: 'not a tributary of' with Deccan rivers
traps.fix: Godavari: Pravara, Purna, Manjira, Manair, Wainganga, Indravati, Sabari. Krishna: Koyna, Bhima, Tungabhadra, Musi.
traps.pyq: Odd one out of Godavari list → Koyna (Krishna tributary) [mains-2017-paper1#71]

traps.trap: Puts a plausible central State on the Tropic of Cancer line
traps.spot: 'crossed / not crossed by Tropic of Cancer'
traps.fix: Recite the 8 States W→E: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram – Odisha and Bihar are not on it.
traps.pyq: Not crossed → Odisha [prelims-2019#36]; crossed → Jharkhand, not Bihar [group2-2008-paper1#116]

traps.trap: Uses one end-point of the Eastern Ghats from a different scale
traps.fix: As a range: Mahanadi valley → Nilgiris. Mahendragiri is the highest peak (and the Srikakulam name); Seshachalam is only the AP southern part.
traps.pyq: Eastern Ghats stretch → Mahanadi valley to the Nilgiris [prelims-2024#43]; in Srikakulam → Mahendra Girulu [mains-2025-paper1#29]

traps.fix: 8° = Minicoy–Maldives; 9° = Minicoy–rest of Lakshadweep; 10° = Andaman–Nicobar. Andrott is the largest island; Kavaratti is the capital.
traps.pyq: 'Nine Degree Channel separates Minicoy from Maldives' is false → 'None of them' [prelims-2024#37]

traps.fix: Hygrometer humidity, hydrometer liquid density; petrology rocks, pedology soils; bathymetry sea depth.
traps.pyq: Humidity → Hygrometer, not Hydrometer [group2-2008-paper1#106]; sea-floor mapping → Bathymetry [prelims-2019#14]

traps.fix: Focus (hypocentre) is underground where energy is released; epicentre is the surface point directly above it and first to feel the waves.
traps.pyq: 'Epicentre is directly below the focus' is the incorrect statement [prelims-2024#32]

traps.trap: Gives the opposite climate condition for a soil
traps.spot: Laterite/black soil statements mentioning rainfall or aridity
traps.fix: Laterite = high rainfall + high temperature → leaching; black soil = Deccan lava, deepest in NW Deccan.
traps.pyq: 'Laterites form in semi-arid low rainfall regions' is incorrect [prelims-2024#49]; deep black soil → NW Deccan [prelims-2024#46]

traps.trap: Swaps a project between the main river and its tributary
traps.spot: AP project–river matching with Penna and Cheyyeru, Krishna and Tungabhadra
traps.fix: Somasila = Penna, Annamayya = Cheyyeru; Sunkesula = Tungabhadra; Prakasam = Krishna; Thotapalli = Nagavali.

traps.spot: Committees or ministries in disaster management
traps.fix: NCMC – Cabinet Secretary; State CMC – Chief Secretary; SDMA – Chief Minister; drought nodal ministry – Agriculture; NDMA conducts mock drills.
traps.pyq: State Crisis Management Committee → Chief Secretary [group2-2012-paper1#89]; drought nodal → Ministry of Agriculture [group2-2012-paper1#88]

traps.trap: Swaps an agent between depositional landforms
traps.fix: Delta – running water; cirque – glacier; cliff – waves; dune – wind.

techniques.name: One sure pair in matching [anchor pair]
techniques.how: Lock the pair you are surest of, drop codes that break it, confirm with a second pair.
techniques.example: Pennar rises in Nandidurga hills (d-II) → only 'a-III, b-IV, c-I, d-II' fits; Gundlakamma–Nallamala confirms [prelims-2024#48]

techniques.name: Recite the ordered list
techniques.how: For belts, ranges and Himalayan divisions, recite the fixed sequence and read the answer off it.
techniques.example: Indus–Satluj Punjab, Satluj–Kali Kumaon, Kali–Tista Nepal → Kumaon Himalayas [prelims-2024#42]

techniques.name: Cause-based elimination for climate terms
techniques.how: Ask what physical process the stem names; options naming other processes fall.
techniques.example: Mountains blocking winds = relief → orographic rain [group2-2008-paper1#109]; NH cyclone inflow → anticlockwise [mains-2017-paper1#58]

techniques.name: Old vs young / active vs extinct split
techniques.how: Sort options into two classes first; usually only one belongs to the asked class.
techniques.example: Appalachians, Aravallis, Urals are old → Alps [prelims-2024#40]; Narcondam dormant, Dhinodhar/Tosham extinct → Barren Island [mains-2017-paper1#52]

techniques.name: AP water number card
techniques.how: Keep fixed numbers of Krishna sharing and APRA water bodies; pick the exact figure, not a near one.

techniques.name: Threshold ladders for hazards
techniques.how: Memorise the cut-offs of a classification, then place the number in the stem.

techniques.name: 'All the above' test in DM questions
techniques.how: Check each option alone; if every one is a genuine component, mark 'all the above'.
techniques.example: DM Act 2005 creates response/mitigation funds and NIDM/NDRF → All the above [group2-2012-paper1#120]

confusions.remember: Focus underground; epicentre on the surface above it.
Bhangar old alluvium on higher ground; khadar new alluvium on flood plains.
Bhabar porous pebble belt at foothills; terai marshy belt south of it.
Narmada at Jabalpur; Jog on Sharavathi.
Kerala–Karnataka pre-monsoon (mango) vs West Bengal–Assam Nor'westers.
ENSO is Pacific; IOD is Indian Ocean.
Meteors burn in the mesosphere; ozone and jet aircraft in the stratosphere.
Tornado is land-based; the others are regional names of tropical cyclones.
NDMA (PM chairs) plans and runs drills; NDRF is the response force.
Penna main stem vs Cheyyeru tributary.

anchors: Tropic of Cancer – 8 States: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram.
Eastern Ghats – Mahanadi valley to Nilgiris; Mahendragiri highest; Satmala belongs to the Deccan (Maharashtra), not the Ghats.
Himalayan divisions – Punjab (Indus–Satluj), Kumaon (Satluj–Kali), Nepal (Kali–Tista), Assam (Tista–Dihang).
Krishna Tribunal shares – AP 512 TMC, Telangana 299 TMC.
Nagarjuna Sagar on Krishna, completed 1967; Polavaram on Godavari (West Godavari side).
Telugu Ganga – Krishna water from Srisailam to Chennai (Tamil Nadu) drinking water.
AP river origins – Pennar: Nandidurga; Gundlakamma: Nallamala; Vamsadhara: Jeypore hills; Machkund: Mudugal.
Atmosphere – N2 78%, O2 21%, Ar 0.93%, CO2 ~0.04%; no chlorine.
Black soil = regur / 'tropical chernozem', swells when wet, cracks when dry.
Tropical deciduous forests are India's most widespread type.
High Powered Committee on DM – 1999; DM Act – 2005; IDNDR – 1990s by UNGA.
ITIC – Honolulu; India's tsunami warning centre – INCOIS, Hyderabad.
checklist: Name the class first (old/young, active/dormant, main river/tributary), then pick.
For any line, belt or range, recite the fixed list in order.
Check sound-alike terms letter by letter (hygro/hydro, bathy/hypso, petro/pedo).
In AP drainage, ask: which river, main stem or tributary, which district?
Disaster bodies: identify the level (national/state/district) and its chair.
Time-sensitive numbers (forest %, moons, coastline): answer per the data of the exam year.
In matching, lock one sure pair before reading the codes.
